data = open('src/test/OpenEXRTest/comp_piz.exr','rb').read()
# parse header: magic(4) + version(4) then null-terminated attrs
i = 8
import struct
while i < len(data):
    # attribute: name (null term), type (null term), size (4), value
    name_start = i
    # find null
    j = data.index(b'\x00', i)
    name = data[i:j]
    i = j+1
    if name == b'':
        # end of header
        print('END OF HEADER at', i)
        break
    k = data.index(b'\x00', i)
    typ = data[i:k]
    i = k+1
    sz = struct.unpack('<I', data[i:i+4])[0]
    i += 4
    val = data[i:i+sz]
    i += sz
    if name in (b'compression', b'channels', b'dataWindow', b'displayWindow', b'lineOrder', b'pixelAspectRatio', b'screenWindowCenter', b'screenWindowWidth'):
        print(name, typ, sz, val.hex() if name not in (b'channels',) else val[:40].hex())
print('after header offset', i)
print('remaining bytes', len(data)-i)
"
